data.one_liner: Platform interface for the audioplayers Flutter plugin.
data.what_it_does: Provides the abstract API that platform-specific implementations of the audioplayers plugin must implement. It defines the contract for playing, pausing, seeking, and managing multiple audio players across Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: You need to create a custom platform implementation for audioplayers.
You want to extend or replace the default audioplayers behavior on a specific platform.
avoid_when: You only need ready‑to‑use audio playback without writing platform code.
strengths: Keeps the core audioplayers plugin platform‑agnostic.
Supports all major Flutter platforms out of the box.
weaknesses: Contains no actual playback functionality itself.
Requires a separate concrete implementation to be useful.

alternatives.name: just_audio_platform_interface
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similar platform interface for the just_audio plugin, useful if you prefer the just_audio API.
